description: This file implements the cache tree data structure and associated functions for managing Git's internal cache representation, including functions for creating, freeing, invalidating, reading, writing, updating, and verifying cache trees, which reflect the directory structure and object identifiers within a Git repository.

methods.name: struct:cache_tree * cache_tree(void)
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new cache_tree object with default values.

methods.name: void cache_tree_free(struct cache_tree ** it_p)
methods.description: Recursively frees memory associated with a cache_tree and its subtrees.

methods.name: int cache_tree_subtree_pos(struct cache_tree * it,const char * path,int pathlen)
methods.description: Performs a binary search to find the position of a subtree given its path.

methods.name: struct:cache_tree_sub * find_subtree(struct cache_tree * it,const char * path,int pathlen,int create)
methods.description: Finds or creates a subtree object within a cache_tree based on a given path.

methods.name: struct:cache_tree_sub * cache_tree_sub(struct cache_tree * it,const char * path)
methods.description: Convenience function to find or create a subtree at a given path.

methods.name: int do_invalidate_path(struct cache_tree * it,const char * path)
methods.description: Invalidates the cache entries for a given path, optionally freeing subtrees.

methods.name: void cache_tree_invalidate_path(struct index_state * istate,const char * path)
methods.description: Invalidates a specific path in the cache tree, marking the cache as changed.

methods.name: int verify_cache(struct index_state * istate,int flags)
methods.description: Verifies the consistency of the cache entries, checking for unmerged entries and conflicting paths.

methods.name: void discard_unused_subtrees(struct cache_tree * it)
methods.description: Removes subtrees that are not marked as used.

methods.name: int cache_tree_fully_valid(struct cache_tree * it)
methods.description: Checks if the cache tree and its subtrees are fully valid by verifying object existence.

methods.name: int must_check_existence(const struct cache_entry * ce)
methods.description: Determines if the existence of a cache entry must be verified based on promisor remote status.

methods.name: int update_one(struct cache_tree * it,struct cache_entry ** cache,int entries,const char * base,int baselen,int * skip_count,int flags)
methods.description: Recursively builds or updates a cache tree for a given set of cache entries, creating tree objects as needed.

methods.name: int cache_tree_update(struct index_state * istate,int flags)
methods.description: Updates the cache tree of the index to reflect current cache entries.

methods.name: void write_one(struct strbuf * buffer,struct cache_tree * it,const char * path,int pathlen)
methods.description: Serializes a cache_tree node and its subtrees into a buffer for writing to disk.

methods.name: void cache_tree_write(struct strbuf * sb,struct cache_tree * root)
methods.description: Writes the entire cache tree into a buffer.

methods.name: int parse_int(const char ** ptr,unsigned long * len_p,int * out)
methods.description: Parses an integer value from a string buffer.

methods.name: struct:cache_tree * read_one(const char ** buffer,unsigned long * size_p)
methods.description: Deserializes a cache_tree structure from a buffer.

methods.name: struct:cache_tree * cache_tree_read(const char * buffer,unsigned long size)
methods.description: Reads and constructs a cache_tree structure from a raw buffer.

methods.name: struct:cache_tree * cache_tree_find(struct cache_tree * it,const char * path)
methods.description: Finds a subtree within a cache_tree given a path.

methods.name: int write_index_as_tree_internal(struct object_id * oid,struct index_state * index_state,int cache_tree_valid,int flags,const char * prefix)
methods.description: Writes the in-memory index's cache tree into a tree object, optionally handling a prefix.

methods.name: struct:tree * write_in_core_index_as_tree(struct repository * repo)
methods.description: Builds a tree object that represents the in-memory index cache in core.

methods.name: int write_index_as_tree(struct object_id * oid,struct index_state * index_state,const char * index_path,int flags,const char * prefix)
methods.description: Creates a tree object from the index on disk, with support for locking and prefix handling.

methods.name: void prime_cache_tree_sparse_dir(struct cache_tree * it,struct tree * tree)
methods.description: Initializes a cache_tree for a sparse directory entry.

methods.name: void prime_cache_tree_rec(struct repository * r,struct cache_tree * it,struct tree * tree,struct strbuf * tree_path)
methods.description: Recursively constructs cache_tree structure from a repository tree object.

methods.name: void prime_cache_tree(struct repository * r,struct index_state * istate,struct tree * tree)
methods.description: Constructs the cache_tree from a repository tree to facilitate sparse index and cache management.

methods.name: struct:cache_tree * find_cache_tree_from_traversal(struct cache_tree * root,struct traverse_info * info)
methods.description: Finds the cache_tree corresponding to the current directory level based on traversal info.

methods.name: int cache_tree_matches_traversal(struct cache_tree * root,struct name_entry * ent,struct traverse_info * info)
methods.description: Checks if a given index entry matches the cache_tree at the current traversal point.

methods.name: int verify_one_sparse(struct index_state * istate,struct strbuf * path,int pos)
methods.description: Verifies that sparse directory entries are consistent.

methods.name: int verify_one(struct repository * r,struct index_state * istate,struct cache_tree * it,struct strbuf * path)
methods.description: Recursively verifies the integrity and consistency of the cache_tree against index entries.

methods.name: int cache_tree_verify(struct repository * r,struct index_state * istate)
methods.description: Validates the cache_tree structure of the index, ensuring it matches the underlying data.

methods.name: int subtree_name_cmp(const char * one,int onelen,const char * two,int twolen)
methods.description: unavailable
